proposals.downside_risk: None to trading behavior — this is a measurement-only audit, not a strategy or execution change.

evidence.detail: net = gross - gas_native - builder_native computed only in the clean on-chain-delta case
WRAPPED_BASE_INFLOW_ONLY / TOKEN_DELTA_ONLY proof states report net=None or net=gross when a clean net delta cannot be proven, i.e. gas/builder costs are not subtracted for that subset of trades

proposals.expected_effect: Quantifying the fallback-state frequency reveals whether current EVM net-P&L reporting materially overstates profitability; if material, motivates a follow-up engineering fix to close the proof gap.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 100 closed EVM trades or 30 days of trade logs, whichever is available first.
proposals.rationale: If a material share of EVM closed trades fall into the gross-only proof states, reported net P&L is upward-biased for that subset since real gas/builder costs were paid but never subtracted, directly undermining the objective of durable money-weighted NET P&L after fees.
proposals.shadow_test: Deterministic log audit (no capital at risk): sample the last N closed EVM trades' profit-state field distribution, compute the percentage falling into WRAPPED_BASE_INFLOW_ONLY/TOKEN_DELTA_ONLY vs clean-delta, and report the notional dollar amount affected. Stop condition: none needed, this is a read-only audit, not a live test.

proposals.downside_risk: SHADOW evaluation consumes engineering/observation time without guaranteed promotion; premature promotion without sufficient sample would introduce an unvetted live strategy and must not bypass the existing promotion gate.

evidence.detail: Module explicitly 'deliberately pure and SHADOW-only'; contains momentum, mean-reversion, arbitrage, and ML-forecast signal evaluators never wired to live execution
Stated objective: bot 'must not depend only on following leader wallets'
Primary and only LIVE strategy family is leader-wallet copy-trading on both chains

proposals.expected_effect: Continued/expanded non-signing SHADOW-mode data collection on cross_chain_strategy_signals.py moves the bot toward the existing STRATEGY_LAB promotion gate (profit factor >= 1.10 plus human approval per docs/STRATEGY_LAB.md:85-90), creating a genuine second live-eligible strategy family and reducing single-signal concentration risk over time.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 4-6 weeks of continuous non-signing SHADOW logging per chain, consistent with the existing STRATEGY_LAB promotion gate's own sufficiency bar (not a new bar).
proposals.rationale: Current live capital allocation is concentrated in a single signal family (leader-copy) structurally correlated to tracked wallets' own edge decay, detection, or front-running risk. The documented alternative quant signal family remains unpromoted SHADOW-only, so the bot's own stated diversification goal is unmet, leaving no fallback signal source if leader-copy edge degrades.
proposals.shadow_test: Keep cross_chain_strategy_signals.py evaluators running in non-signing SHADOW mode on both chains; log each signal family's would-be net edge (after modeled fees/slippage/gas) separately from the leader-copy SHADOW baseline. Fail/stop condition: a signal family is dropped from further consideration if it fails to reach the existing profit-factor >= 1.10 gate after the minimum observation window.

proposals.downside_risk: Added idempotency/nonce-management complexity could itself introduce bugs (e.g. incorrectly suppressing a legitimate retry) if not carefully tested; must not weaken existing gas-reserve or min-profit checks.

evidence.detail: _base_tx fetches nonce via get_transaction_count(address, 'pending') fresh on every call with no idempotency key or fee-bump retry logic for slow/stuck transactions
Quarantine only reacts to revert-pattern strikes post-hoc; it does not manage nonce state or dedupe pre-broadcast

proposals.expected_effect: Reduces incidence of duplicate-fill / stuck-nonce execution failures, improving the EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE component of net P&L without altering signal logic.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 200 simulated concurrent-trigger scenarios, or 2 weeks of execution-quarantine log review, whichever surfaces more concurrent-race events.
proposals.rationale: Pending-nonce reads without a dedupe/idempotency layer create a plausible path to double-submission or nonce collisions if a transaction is slow to confirm and a retry path fires (watchdog restart, manual re-trigger, concurrent worker race). This would surface as EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE loss (wasted gas, orphaned tx, stuck nonce blocking the queue) rather than a strategy signal problem, and is architecturally plausible though not confirmed by runtime evidence this cycle.
proposals.shadow_test: In a non-signing SHADOW/testnet harness, simulate concurrent execution triggers against the same nonce slot (deliberately delay confirmation, then fire a second trigger) and count double-submit/stuck-nonce occurrences before vs after adding an idempotency key plus fee-bump-based retry. Stop/fail condition: roll back if the guard suppresses more than 1% of legitimate first-attempt broadcasts in dry-run replay.

proposals.downside_risk: None from verification itself; if a subsequent fix over-tightens slippage bounds, it could increase failed/unfilled orders in volatile conditions.

evidence.detail: _order() calls Jupiter's /order endpoint; static reading did not confirm slippageBps/priority-fee params are explicitly set at request time
live_order_slippage_bps (default 50bps) and combined-impact ceilings are enforced as a separate, apparently post-hoc, economic guard layer

proposals.expected_effect: Confirming (and if needed, fixing) that slippageBps is passed at request time would tighten actual execution slippage rather than only bounding it after quoting.
proposals.minimum_observation: N/A for verification; if a fix proceeds to SHADOW testing, at least 100 SHADOW orders per variant.
proposals.rationale: If slippageBps is only enforced as a post-hoc rejection check rather than passed to Jupiter's own routing at quote/order time, worse-than-necessary fills could still be attempted and only rejected after the fact (or accepted within the post-hoc ceiling but worse than optimal), directly affecting realized slippage cost — a direct NET P&L driver on Solana.
proposals.shadow_test: Not applicable for the verification step. If the gap is confirmed, A/B compare fill rate and realized slippage bps in SHADOW mode between request-time-bounded vs current post-hoc-only-bounded order flow.

proposals.downside_risk: None from research itself; changing sizing without evidence of intent could re-expose the account to HOOD-style concentration risk if the fixed cap was deliberate.

evidence.detail: shadow_allocation_sol is a fixed nominal amount (0.05 SOL) regardless of account capital or opportunity liquidity
EVM sizing uses allocation_pct, a percentage of chain capital, by contrast

proposals.expected_effect: Clarifying intent avoids either leaving Solana capital under-deployed as the account grows, or mistakenly recommending a change that removes an intentional post-incident safety constraint.
proposals.rationale: A fixed-nominal Solana position size does not scale with account capital growth or per-opportunity liquidity/volatility, unlike EVM's percentage-based approach. It is unclear from architecture alone whether this is a deliberate HOOD-incident-driven risk containment choice (learnerbot/solana_pool_risk_gate.py was built from that post-mortem) or a legacy default, which matters for interpreting cross-chain net-P&L comparisons under a like-for-like economic lens.
proposals.shadow_test: Not applicable for the research step. If ambiguous after reviewing config history/comments around live_max_positions and shadow_allocation_sol, run a SHADOW-only paper comparison of fixed vs liquidity-scaled sizing.

rejected_ideas.idea: Add classical TA indicators (RSI/MACD/moving averages) to the live signal set.
rejected_ideas.reason: No backtest engine exists in this repo to validate such indicators, and there is no runtime evidence that the current leader-copy signal is underperforming; adding indicators without a validation path risks unfounded, unfalsifiable strategy churn.

rejected_ideas.idea: Immediately switch Solana position sizing to percentage-of-capital to match EVM.
rejected_ideas.reason: The fixed-nominal Solana size may be an intentional post-HOOD-incident containment measure; changing it without confirming intent or running a SHADOW comparison risks reintroducing the concentration risk the HOOD post-mortem was meant to fix.

rejected_ideas.idea: Recommend a specific wallet/signing architecture change (e.g. HSM, remote signer).
rejected_ideas.reason: Wallet/signing is an explicitly protected domain per repository instructions and outside a pure P&L strategy review's scope; flagged only as an evidence gap, not proposed as a change.

summary: Architecture-only review (no runtime forensics available this cycle). Primary LIVE strategy is single-family leader-wallet copy-trading on both chains, with a documented diversification goal unmet since the alternative quant signal family remains SHADOW-only. Chain-specific execution cost controls (slippage, gas/priority fees, liquidity/sellability gates) exist and are incident-derived (HOOD post-mortem), but two measurement/infrastructure gaps could distort durable NET P&L: EVM gross-only P&L fallback states, and absent EVM nonce dedupe/retry logic. All proposals are architecture-level hypotheses requiring SHADOW evidence before any live change; no live-readiness or profitability claim is made.
